title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: CJ CUP Byron Nelson
items.text: Si Woo Kim leads at 20-under through 7 holes, with Tom Hoge three shots behind at 17-under, and a trio including Zach Bauchou at 16-under.

items.headline: Kim wants Scheffler pairing
items.text: Si Woo Kim hopes to play Sunday’s final group with Scottie Scheffler after good conversations during earlier rounds at THE CJ CUP Byron Nelson.

items.headline: Renovation sparks low scores
items.text: TPC Craig Ranch’s $25 million renovation and preferred lies helped scores tumble, keeping the CJ CUP Byron Nelson leaderboard fluid on Saturday.
